# Pika Uruguay

<!-- Generated from manifest.json by scripts/build.js. Do not edit by hand. -->

Uruguayan shop selling board and card games, puzzles, children's books, colouring pads and build-it-yourself games, many with Uruguayan themes, organised by age. Ships nationwide and offers free pickup in Pocitos, Montevideo.

*ES:* Tienda uruguaya de juegos de mesa y cartas, puzzles, libros infantiles, blocks para colorear y juegos para armar, muchos con temática uruguaya, organizados por edad. Envía a todo el país y ofrece retiro gratis en Pocitos, Montevideo.
